facts.text: Serve the snacks when Ray and Frank arrive in Hong Kong.
facts.why: Frank Dux arrives in Hong Kong alone and then befriends Ray Jackson, so they do not arrive together.
facts.fix: Serve the snacks when Frank lands in Hong Kong and meets Ray.

facts.text: I came for my teacher. Now I'm in it for the dumplings after the bout.
facts.why: Frank never says this. The quote page lists his real lines. It is printed in quote marks as his words.
facts.fix: Aren't you a little old for videogames?

fix_note.text: Aren't you a little old for videogames?

facts.why: Frank's teacher is Senzo Tanaka. There is no Tiger Tanaka in the film (Tiger Tanaka is a James Bond name). Senzo's son is Shingo.

vibe.verdict: The scoreboard and ticket look suit a fight night, and the Hong Kong street food is spot on, but the quote is made up and a teacher is misnamed.
